Release-prep run of the standing P0 smoke. Text only; the durable truth stays in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`. ## Environment fingerprint - **Framework:** `objectstack-ai/objectstack` `ef1ed17f` = `main` `2f2fa11b` + one docs-only checklist commit (PR #21027, a source-citation re-point; no runtime change). - **Console:** objectui pin `.objectui-sha` = `db11afd4967c`, built by `pnpm objectui:build`; `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha` matches the pin. Built under Node v22.22.2 because the container's v22.22.0 fails objectui's `engine-strict` install (`jsdom@30.0.1` requires `^22.22.2`) — an environment note, not a product finding. - **Framework build:** `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build` → `Tasks: 72 successful, 72 total`. - **App / boots:** `examples/app-showcase`, `OS_PORT=

objectstack dev --seed-admin -p

-d file:` (`--ui` for browser items); seed `com.example.showcase 132 rows` (19 datasets); banner `Tenancy: single`; ports 41000–41799, one file DB per item. Member personas via admin `invite-member` + `sign-up/email` (stock audience posture is `invite_only`). - **Execution:** 5 parallel runner subagents (A1, A2, B, C1, C2) + 3 independent verifiers (V1–V3, RUNNER rule 7) in Claude Code session `session_01MRdbfpy4sQT8bUjmMhxsN7`, 2026-10-01 02:31–03:45Z. Environment prep ≈ 25 min (including the console rebuild); per-runner item time 17–50 min. ## Scope Selector `priority:P0` (`node scripts/checklist-select.mjs priority:P0 --json`) → **19 runnable items**. Hidden as blocked (not run): `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics`. Disposition: product defect in showcase authoring (verifier V1 confirmed; platform behaves per spec). Sanitized card: #21052. **F2 · access-security.crud-permission-matrix · A1** — the delegated admin cannot administer inside its own subtree on a stock dev boot (fails closed — over-refusal, not an exposure). Verifier V1: CONFIRMED, product defect. 1. Fresh boot; admin invites + signs up a delegate D and a target T. 2. Admin: `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_permission_set {"user_id":D,"permission_set_id":}` → 201; `POST /api/v1/data/sys_business_unit_member {"business_unit_id":"bu_field_ops","user_id":D}` → 201. 3. D: `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position {"user_id":T,"position":"contributor","business_unit_id":"bu_west_coast"}` (child of `bu_field_ops`; `contributor` binds only `showcase_contributor`, which is on the set's `assignablePermissionSets`). 4. Expected 2xx (the set's `adminScope` is `Field Operations` + subtree). Actual: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED "delegated 'insert' on sys_user_position rejected — business unit 'bu_west_coast' is outside the delegated subtree"`. Admin posting the identical payload → 201. 5. Oracle for the mechanism: every seeded `sys_business_unit` row has `organization_id: null`, every session carries an `activeOrganizationId`. Admin stamping the org onto the seeded units flips D's call to 201. **F3 · api-backend.query-contract-matrix · A6** — verifier V2: CONFIRMED as written, **disposition: stale clause** (not a product defect). 1. Fresh boot, admin bearer. `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task/query {"where":{"status":{"$nin":"done"}}}` → 400 `{"error":"Invalid query request","code":"VALIDATION_FAILED","fields":[{"field":"query.where.status.$nin",…"requires an ARRAY of values. Received string (\"done\")…"}]}`. 2. `{"where":["status","not_in","done"]}` → 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` at `query.where`. 3. Control: `GET …/showcase_task?$filter=["status","not_in","done"]` → 400 `INVALID_FILTER`; `$nin:["done"]` → 200, 8 rows. Nothing widens, never 500. 4. Why stale: #20116 moved this refusal into the request schema (`FilterConditionSchema.superRefine(checkFilterConditionComparands)`), and the POST door answers schema failures with `VALIDATION_FAILED` — a posture pinned by `rest-server-repeated-filter-param.test.ts` and `analytics-filter-refusal-envelope.test.ts`. The clause (rev 2, 2026-08-18) predates it. **F4 · integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix · N2** — verifier V2: CONFIRMED, product defect (no credential exposed). 1. Fresh boot, admin bearer. `POST /api/v1/datasources {"name":"r19b_mg_nouser","driver":"mongodb","config":{"url":"mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/qa"},"secret":"any-secret"}` → **201**; `GET /api/v1/datasources/r19b_mg_nouser` → 200 `hasSecret:true`; `GET /api/v1/meta/datasource/r19b_mg_nouser` → `_diagnostics.valid:false` "this mongo `config.url` names no user in its userinfo while `external.credentialsRef` binds a secret". 2. Composed variant `{"config":{"host":"127.0.0.1","database":"qa"},"secret":"any"}` → 201 too. 3. Controls: the same pairing through `PUT /api/v1/meta/datasource/` (with `external.credentialsRef`) → 422 INVALID_METADATA; `objectstack build` of a stack declaring it → exit 2. **F5 · approvals.account-app-entry · A7** — verifier V3: CONFIRMED, product defect, console-wide (not approvals-specific). 1. Fresh boot; persona (or admin) signs in at `/_console/login`; avatar → Language → 中文（中国）. 2. Full page load of `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/component/approvals/inbox`. 3. Expected h1 审批中心, tabs 待我审批 / 我发起的 / 全部, badge 待审批. Actual: h1 "Approvals Inbox", tabs "My Pending / Submitted by me / All", badge "Pending"; nav label 待我审批 (server-translated); `localStorage['objectui-locale']="zh-CN"`, ``; resource entries list only `i18n-locale-en-*.js`. SPA navigation right after a fresh sign-in fetches `i18n-locale-zh-*.js` and renders Chinese; a reload reverts. **F6 · studio-authoring.first-run-loop · A1** — verifier V3: CONFIRMED, product defect in the console build integration; **release-relevant**. 1. Fresh boot `--ui`; admin → `/_console/studio` → "New package (writable base)". 2. Expected a dialog with Name / Id / Namespace whose "Create package" sends `POST /api/v1/packages`. Actual: only `#mdf-version` and `#mdf-type`; notices "Field name / id / namespace / description declared in form layout but missing from schema. Skipping."; "Create package" disabled; no POST. Console: `[package-schema] failed to derive manifest JSONSchema from spec TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'push')`. 3. Control: `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{…}}` → 201 (server door fine; client-only). 4. Same failure class on the Studio dashboard / report inspectors ("Spec schema unavailable — basic properties only"). The published `@objectstack/console@17.5.0` carries the same two-zod bundle (static evidence). ## Fixture gaps and environment notes - Stock posture `invite_only`: every "fresh sign-up" persona needs an admin `invite-member` first (or `create-user` + `change-password`). - `crud-permission-matrix` A6 unobservable on stock (guest anchor unbound; REST anonymous 401). - No real Postgres/MySQL/Mongo runnable in the sandbox; the datasource connect legs used a wire-level fake PG. - Sandbox egress denies `cloud.objectos.ai` (marketplace catalog) and map tiles. - The container's Node v22.22.0 is below the pinned objectui's `jsdom` engine floor; the console was built with Node v22.22.2. - Runner port ranges should exclude the egress proxy's `127.0.0.1:41333`. Close-out (extracted cards, checklist-accuracy findings) follows in a comment. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
